text: A farmer hoed his field one early morning in the spring
Out of the grass a hare came racing on the wing
It hit an old tree stump and then it lay still
Dinner for free, he laughed, why should I work at all
He laid his hoe down by the stump and waited for the call
Days went by, the weeds grew tall
Weeks went by, no hare at all
By autumn his field was wild, his rice bowl empty too
His neighbors carried home their rice, he waited, as fools do
Luck visits once, but work will feed you every day
